therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: cell cycle arrest and tumor cell proliferation inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: postmenopausal women with ER+/HER2- advanced breast cancer

results.target_engagement_evidence: Plasma trough concentrations at steady-state: Cycle 1 Day 14: 70.1 ng/mL, Cycle 2 Day 14: 64.2 ng/mL
biomarker_changes: Rb positive tumors showed greater benefit (HR 0.531, 95% CI 0.416-0.680)
Cyclin D1 positive tumors showed greater benefit (HR 0.555, 95% CI 0.437-0.705)
Ki67 ≤20% tumors showed greater benefit (HR 0.530, 95% CI 0.379-0.742)
p16 H-Score <175 showed greater benefit (HR 0.581, 95% CI 0.455-0.742)
subgroup_findings: Cyclin D1 positive: PFS 24.8 vs 13.8 months (HR 0.555)
safety_signals: Temporary discontinuation due to AEs: 79.7% vs 17.1%
Dose reduction due to AEs: 41.9% vs 2.3%
results.dose_information: Palbociclib 125mg orally once daily on Days 1-21 of every 28-day cycle (3 weeks on, 1 week off) plus Letrozole 2.5mg orally once daily continuously
